watch.summary: A Rocket League streamer loudly claims he fears no man, only to immediately get scored on.

beats.what: Creator talks smack, saying 'You think I'm afraid of you?'
Creator screams as he whiffs the ball.
Creator recovers and boasts 'I fear no man...'
The opponent scores a goal instantly as he finishes the sentence.
Creator cracks up laughing at his own immediate failure.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The classic hubris-followed-by-instant-defeat trope delivers strong comedic timing. His immediate laughter at his own premature boast cements the self-own.
